entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-09-28
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Unions: exhaustive switch statement ending a method emits invalid IL in Release (InvalidProgramException) #85809
  • Speculative semantic model for an isolated AttributeSyntax incorrectly disables nullable analysis #85807
  • Speculative semantic model for a parameter's default value incorrectly disables nullable analysis #85806
  • ImportAdder hardcodes CRLF for the added using when the document has no line break, ignoring the configured NewLine #85804

Closed

  • [AI artifact audit] AI guidance audit: duplicated maintenance rules #85812
  • Language server test hangs on Linux due to exception thrown by FBA #84984
  • Code style is not enforced internally #85813
    Backlog
  • BannedApiAnalyzers exclude_generated_code does not suppress RS0030 for Microsoft.AspNetCore.OpenApi source-generated syntax trees #84321
    18.10

PullRequests

Created

  • Avoid crash when describing generic cref completions #85817
    VSCode
  • Also filter out methods hidden by non-browsable methods in completion #85816
    Community, VSCode
  • Support per-client project autoload initialization options #85814
    VSCode
  • Fix unexpected System.ArrayTypeMismatchException for captured method call receivers #85811
    Area-Compilers
  • Enforce BOM configuration in CI #85810
    VSCode, Area-Razor
  • Propagate StateWhenNotNull through lifted logical NOT in NullableWalker #85808
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • Implement OnDemand Project Loading #85805
    VSCode

Merged

  • Reduce Roslyn editor exception overhead #85240
    Community, Next
  • Add Razor language version 12 #85720
    Area-Razor, Next
  • Deduplicate agent documentation maintenance guidance #85815
    Next
  • FileBasedProgramsEntryPointDiscovery: Use File.Move instead of File.Replace for cache file #85763
    VSCode, Next

Updated

  • Migrate tests to xUnit v3 #85776
    VSCode, Area-Razor
  • Update Gladstone and related SDK assemblies #85748
    VSCode, Area-Razor
  • Rationalize the different command lines for RunTests #83827
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Add the documentation directive to the Razor compiler #85723
    Area-Razor
  • Add code actions for documentation diagnostics #85728
    Area-Razor
  • Add semantic-token support for documentation directives #85724
    Area-Razor
  • Add folding ranges for documentation directives #85725
    Area-Razor
  • Add documentation formatting and typing support #85726
    Area-Razor
  • Add documentation completion and snippets #85727
    Area-Razor
  • Add XML parsing mode to the Razor markup parser #85721
    Area-Razor
  • Remove legacy pull diagnostics methods #85702
    Community, VSCode, Area-Razor
  • Convert generic brackets to braces when pasting into cref #85787
    Area-IDE, Community
  • Don't report cascading CS0131 for invalid initializer member assignments #85798
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • Reduce IL size for constructing `ImmutableArray<T>` of small sizes #85797
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • Revert "Avoid constructor-time ownership for compiler client mutexes (#85675)" #85782
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • Avoid dereferencing a reference assigned to a discard #85750
    Area-Compilers
  • Add TargetsTriggeredAfterCSharpCompilation target #85681
  • Fix nullable analysis for collection expression spreads #85785
    Community
  • Localized file check-in by OneLocBuild Task: Build definition ID 327: Build ID 3089427 #85796
